name: dynamic-plateau-border-t1-transition
claim_boundary: Bounded reduced-order liquid-border control-volume hydrodynamics for one isolated four-region curvilinear 3D T1 neighborhood. Liquid state, Young-Laplace pressure, Poiseuille redistribution and viscous resistance evolve in time and determine event timing; the surrounding-film traction is measured from the resolved mesh. This is not resolved singular multiphase Navier-Stokes or unrestricted arbitrary 3D T1 CFD.
